correctness.rationale: For A=diag(kappa,1,1), exact multiplication gives rank-two Nyström spectrum {kappa/h,1}; the published normalization reduces P to I+sww^T. Its 2×2 generalized polynomial has positive eigenvalues lambda-<b<lambda+, so the complete 3×3 condition ratio is lambda+/lambda-. The trace/product identity gives S²−H²(1+s)=s(kappa−1)G/(bh); positivity factors are independently justified. G(0)>0, G(1)<0 and G′′>0 yield one crossing. The 5,3,3 rational witness has exact positive certificate 1194450/1075369 and normalized condition ratio >3/2. Analytic continuity, not finite trials, gives an open Gaussian event for each kappa,eta; rank-one/full-rank reductions prove smallest dimension. The actual standalone verify.py passed its exact witness and 210 parameter checks; these are auxiliary.

value.rationale: Nyström preconditioning is intended to improve the spectrum, while source theorems guarantee good expected conditioning only at a sufficiently large effective-dimension rank. The theorem supplies the exact, unique sketch-alignment threshold for every spike contrast and regularization strength, a nonempty open Gaussian failure event, and a minimal-dimensional obstruction. These quantify a practically motivated finite-rank limitation of a published algorithm beyond a single isolated numerical counterexample. It does not claim PCG iteration-count worsening or benefits for all sketches.
